final: WITH color_counts AS (SELECT p.product_color, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS item_count FROM Products AS p LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), color_stats AS (SELECT item_count, AVG(item_count) OVER () AS average_per_color FROM color_counts) SELECT AVG(item_count) AS average_count, AVG(1.0 * item_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice_Line_Items)) AS average_share, AVG(item_count - average_per_color) AS average_excess FROM color_stats WHERE item_count > average_per_color
